title: Login/logout, wrong PIN and account isolation
steps: Sign in/out using Shivani; enter invalid PIN; switch roles and revisit protected routes.
expected: Correct customer home, no other user cart/session, valid credential restored.

title: Registration and approval reflection
steps: Type every registration field continuously; submit pending fixture; admin approves.
expected: No input remount, pending state, admin signup notice, approved account gains ordering access.

title: Cart add/minus/remove/reorder, live prices and stock
steps: Add/change/remove lines; change price/stock as admin; switch identity and restart.
expected: Live line totals, minimum/free-delivery threshold, unavailable checkout guard, scoped persistence.

title: Instant/scheduled windows and address snapshot
steps: Place both slot types; toggle instant during checkout; change slots; save address.
expected: Exact selected slot, current address on new purchase, previous snapshots unchanged; obsolete choices rejected.

title: Every order status and cancellation race
steps: Observe placed, assigned, packed, out-for-delivery, delivered/cancelled and partial recovery.
expected: Current status, notices and history agree; stale packed cancellation rejected; debt remains tracked.

title: Expense dashboard and top products at each stage
steps: Compare baseline, placement, packing, COD/UPI delivery, cancellation, partial/final recovery and date filters.
expected: Only delivered retail totals include fees; chart reconciles; category/product item spend excludes delivery fee; recovery is excluded.

title: Self PIN change, admin reset, third-failure help
steps: Fail 3 times, inspect support links and admin help, reset during active delivery, change with current PIN.
expected: One addressed help alert per threshold cycle, warm invalidation, no work lost, success exits form, original known PIN restored after test.

title: All customer controls, empty/error/offline and external actions
steps: Exercise every inventoried User control in normal/invalid/cancel/repeated-tap paths.
expected: Visible state/route expected; errors are not empty success; no accidental call/message/payment.
